# vertical-pod-autoscaler-crds

<!-- GENERATED by tooling/crdgen. Do not edit. -->

CustomResourceDefinitions for the Kubernetes Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VerticalPodAutoscaler, checkpoints).

CRDs are copied verbatim from [kubernetes/autoscaler](https://github.com/kubernetes/autoscaler)
at tag [`vertical-pod-autoscaler-1.8.0`](https://github.com/kubernetes/autoscaler/tree/vertical-pod-autoscaler-1.8.0) (commit `238579734e73e4a263d1ab75a44353e58eeee3ea`),
path(s) `vertical-pod-autoscaler/deploy/vpa-v1-crd-gen.yaml`, and rendered as regular Helm templates so that
`helm upgrade` updates them (Helm's own `crds/` directory never upgrades).

## Install

```sh
helm install vertical-pod-autoscaler oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/vertical-pod-autoscaler-crds --version <version>
```

Chart `version` equals the upstream version it ships; `appVersion` is always the exact upstream version.
Installing requires Kubernetes >=1.25.0.

### Already have these CRDs?

If the CRDs were installed by the operator chart or `kubectl apply`, Helm refuses with
"rendered manifests contain a resource that already exists". Either let Helm adopt them:

```sh
helm install vertical-pod-autoscaler oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/vertical-pod-autoscaler-crds --version <version> --take-ownership   # Helm >= 3.17
```

or, on older Helm, hand them over first (replace `<release>` and `<namespace>`):

```sh
kubectl annotate crd verticalpodautoscalercheckpoints.autoscaling.k8s.io verticalpodautoscalers.autoscaling.k8s.io \
  meta.helm.sh/release-name=<release> meta.helm.sh/release-namespace=<namespace> --overwrite
kubectl label crd verticalpodautoscalercheckpoints.autoscaling.k8s.io verticalpodautoscalers.autoscaling.k8s.io \
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=Helm --overwrite
```
